title: Back Rank Mate #1
explanation: Ra8# delivers checkmate on the back rank. The black king is trapped by its own pawns on f7, g7, and h7.

title: Back Rank Mate #2
explanation: Rd8# is checkmate. The rook controls the entire 8th rank and the king has no escape.

title: Knight Fork
explanation: Ng5 attacks both the undefended bishop on f7 (forking the king!) creating a devastating threat.

title: Develop and Pin
explanation: Bg2 develops the bishop to a great square, preparing to control the long diagonal and potentially pin pieces.

title: Escape the Scholars Mate
explanation: After Qxf7+, Black must block with Ke7, but then Qe8# is checkmate. This is the famous Scholar's Mate!

title: King and Rook vs King
explanation: Rd5+ checks the black king! The white king and rook work together to drive the enemy king to the edge.

title: Bishop Capture
explanation: Bxc6 wins a pawn. The bishop captures the pawn on c6, gaining material advantage.

title: Queen Promotion
explanation: e1=Q! The pawn promotes to a queen, immediately threatening checkmate and winning the game.

title: Central Knight Fork
explanation: Nxe5! White wins a pawn. The knight on e5 is protected by the bishop on c4 and attacks the bishop on c6.

title: Rook to 8th Rank
explanation: Rd8# is checkmate! The rook slides to the 8th rank and the black king has no escape due to the pawns on f7, g7, and h7.
